outcome: misconceptions and erroneous beliefs about HIV/AIDS
attitudes towards HIV/AIDS patients (e.g., isolation, divine punishment belief)
belief in religion's role in limiting disease spread
cohort: 1,038 Bahraini adults completed a self-administered questionnaire-based survey.
finding: The study found good general awareness among the Bahraini public regarding HIV/AIDS, but also identified common misconceptions and predominantly negative attitudes towards HIV/AIDS patients.
